title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
summary: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE is a Square Enix game coming to Switch 2 on October 22, 2026. The US eShop currently lists a 12.7 GB download; that is an estimate before release, and the final size often changes on launch day, so we will update it once the game is out. The physical edition is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only holds a key and the game itself downloads. Square Enix has not published resolution or frame-rate figures for the Switch 2 version yet. The eShop lists it at $49.99 with five languages, including Spanish.
